historias.titulo: The Rice and the Phone Call
lineas: Daniel
Well, last night I was cooking rice for my girlfriend.
Pues, anoche estaba haciendo arroz para mi novia.
Daniel
While the rice was cooking, my mom called me, you know?
Mientras se cocía el arroz, me llamó mi mamá, ¿sabes?
Daniel
We were talking for almost forty minutes, so I forgot everything.
Estuvimos platicando casi cuarenta minutos, así que se me olvidó todo.
Daniel
Honestly, the kitchen smelled worse than my brother's old socks.

Daniel
The rice was black, and the pot was the dirtiest thing ever.
El arroz quedó negro, y la olla era lo más sucio del mundo.
Daniel
My girlfriend arrived at eight, but dinner wasn't ready.
Mi novia llegó a las ocho, pero la cena no estaba lista.
Daniel
She laughed and said, 'Don't worry, I'll order some pizza.'
Se rió y dijo: 'No te preocupes, yo pido una pizza.'
Daniel
Anyway, now I have to buy a new pot this weekend.
En fin, ahora tengo que comprar una olla nueva este fin de semana.
Daniel
Next time, I should turn off the stove before I answer.
La próxima vez, debería apagar la estufa antes de contestar.

Last Sunday, my boyfriend's parents came to my apartment for dinner.

I was trying to cook and wrap your gift at the same time.

Oh no! What happened? Did it rain on your guests?

No, the weather was perfect. I was cooking twenty burgers.
No, el clima estaba perfecto. Estaba haciendo veinte hamburguesas.

lineas: Valeria
Thanks for coming, Andrés. I have to finish packing by tonight.

No problem. I'll carry the heavy boxes. Which one is the heaviest?

That one, with my books. Careful, it's heavier than it looks.

Wow, you're right! So, are you nervous about the new city?

You'll make friends fast, I promise. You're the funniest person I know.

Valeria
Aw, thanks. By the way, will you visit me in the summer?
